facts.text: Trailing-twelve-month revenue is ₹3.01 lakh cr, +11% on the prior twelve months.
Trailing-twelve-month PAT is ₹20,895 cr, +9% on the prior twelve months.
Sep 2026 quarter: revenue ₹78,750 cr (+16% YoY), PAT ₹5,949 cr (+27% YoY), operating margin 11.2%.
Revenue has compounded at 11% over 10 years, 16% over 5 and 16% over 3.
Profit and revenue have compounded at a similar pace over 3 years (17% vs 16%).
Operating margin is steady at 11.2% (12.5% a year ago).
Borrowings are ₹1.40 lakh cr against equity of ₹1.13 lakh cr: debt/equity 1.24× (was 1.35× in Mar 2023).
Gross debt is 3.8× trailing operating profit — more than three years of EBITDA.
Operating profit plus other income covers interest 4.3× over the last twelve months.
The cash conversion cycle has lengthened to −151 days from −172 in Mar 2023 (payable days 302 → 265, debtor days 89 → 77): more cash is tied up in operations.
Over 5 years, ₹86,099 cr of operating cash came from ₹1.51 lakh cr of operating profit: 57% conversion; against PAT of ₹75,124 cr that is 1.1×.
Free cash flow was negative in 0 of the last 5 years; cumulative ₹67,047 cr, latest year ₹12,272 cr.

business.what: Larsen & Toubro is a technology-led engineering and construction company. It generates revenue through EPC projects in infrastructure, energy, oil & gas, and process industries, alongside manufacturing high-tech equipment, modules, and providing various engineering, technology, and financial services.
business.geography: The company operates globally, executing EPC projects and providing services across various international markets in addition to its domestic operations.

claims.claim: The decline in EBITDA margin is mainly reflective of lower execution in the PPM business, forex variation in the IT subsidiaries, and higher ECL or credit provisions.
claims.quote: The decline in EBITDA margin is mainly reflective of lower execution in the PPM business, forex variation in the IT subsidiaries, and higher ECL or credit provisions.

claims.claim: The divestment of Nabha Power was completed on 25th June 2026, in line with our strategy to exit the concessions portfolio.
claims.quote: The divestment of Nabha Power was completed on 25th June 2026, in line with our strategy to exit the concessions portfolio.

claims.claim: Energy segment margins were impacted by cost overruns and closeout costs in legacy projects.
claims.quote: Cost overruns and closeout costs in legacy projects impacted the segment margin.

claims.claim: The private sector share of the domestic order book has risen from 21% in March '25 to 39% in March '26.
claims.quote: It is worth highlighting that the Private Sector share has risen meaningfully from 21% in March '25 to 39% in March '26

claims.claim: Logistics and insurance costs have increased materially due to the West Asia conflict.
claims.quote: In terms of input costs, the most significant impact has been in logistics and insurance, which have increased materially.

claims.claim: Hydrocarbon margin decline is due to cost overruns in a few projects which are in their final execution phase.
claims.quote: The margin decline in the Hydrocarbons business is primarily due to cost overruns in a few competitively priced domestic and international projects.

claims.claim: Private sector share in the domestic order book has risen from 21% in March 2025 to 36% in December 2025.
claims.quote: It is worth mentioning here that the private sector share has risen meaningfully from 21% in March 2025 to 36% in December 2025

claims.claim: The company has reached an in-principle understanding with the Government of Telangana for the acquisition of its entire stake in L&T Hyderabad Metro.
claims.quote: L&T has reached an in-principle understanding with the Government of Telangana for the acquisition of its entire stake in L&T Hyderabad Metro.

claims.claim: L&T has established itself as a major player and is able to access larger multibillion-dollar projects.
claims.quote: our share of the market was not that good in the previous years, and we have established ourselves now as a major player. So, we are able to access larger market share

claims.claim: L&T expects to divest its entire stake in Hyderabad Metro to the Government of Telangana by the end of FY26.
claims.quote: we expect this transaction to get consummated by the end of the current fiscal FY '26.

claims.claim: Energy segment margins were impacted by cost overruns in legacy projects, which are expected to conclude soon.
claims.quote: The margin decline for the quarter in the Hydrocarbons business was primarily due to cost overruns in some few domestic and international projects.

claims.claim: Domestic thermal power market is buoyant due to grid stabilization needs and power demand from AI and data centers.
claims.quote: the market has suddenly become very buoyant and very active because of two reasons. One is that Renewable power round- the-clock availability has become a bit of an issue.

claims.claim: Projects and Manufacturing margins remained stable YoY at 7.6%.
claims.quote: Our margins in the Projects and Manufacturing portfolio at 7.6% have remained stable on a YoY basis.

claims.claim: Prospects pipeline for the remaining nine months is Rs 14.8 trillion, up 63% YoY.
claims.quote: We have a reasonably strong prospects pipeline of Rs.14.8 trillion for the remaining nine months of the current financial year as compared to Rs.9.1 trillion for the same time last year.

claims.claim: Hydrocarbon margin decline is due to execution of competitively priced jobs secured 2-3 years ago.
claims.quote: the jobs that we secured in ‘21-22, they are going into peak execution in the current year. So, the hydrocarbon margins is reflective of those progress of execution

claims.claim: Hyderabad Metro debt needs to reduce from Rs 12,000 crore to Rs 8,000 crore for breakeven.
claims.quote: the debt levels which is today around Rs.12,000-odd crores has to be brought down to Rs.8,000 crores.

claims.claim: The company's order inflows for FY25 grew 18% y-o-y, surpassing expectations for the second consecutive year.
claims.quote: For the last two consecutive years, the group order inflows have actually surpassed our expectations.

claims.claim: The Net Working Capital to Revenue ratio of 11% in March 2025 is the best reported in the last 10 years.
claims.quote: Our Group Net Working Capital at 11% in March '25 is the best we have reported in the last 10 years.

claims.claim: The Projects and Manufacturing portfolio margin of 9.9% in Q4 FY25 represents a 30 bps improvement y-o-y.
claims.quote: The margin of the Projects and Manufacturing portfolio at 9.9% registers a growth of 30 basis points over the corresponding quarter of the previous year.
